source.title: Cincture of Lunar Communion - Wowhead Looter item-side disenchanting counts

quote: This item has been disenchanted 48 times.
notes: live Wowhead cumulative item-side Looter, inspected 2026-11-08 UTC; original item-side cohort (207278), 30 of 48 recorded disenchant operations produced Resonant Crystal (displayed 63%). Source percentages are rounded per-output occurrence rates, NOT counts of output units. Source gives no per-cast output quantity or positive-stack range. Different outputs may occur together (hits may overlap); never infer zero-output operations by subtraction. Original client game build, data collection epoch, gear bonus variant, profession skill, spec and joint distributions unknown. Item-added patch is NOT the observation patch. totalQuantity and histogram remain unknown; exclude from unit-yield EV calculations.

source.title: Priority original Dragonflight ore and milling completed-cast log search

notes: New search pass found no new independently inspectable primary per-operation ledger (completed casts, output occurrence counts, 0/1/2+ stack histogram). Previously documented Bugy, Xenastro, ar_rules, Aary, superbondez and Reddit cohorts are NOT imported again. For prospecting, nominal ore and resourcefulness savings cannot be substituted for completed casts. Firecrawl's authoritative tooltip-fetch pathway failed for lack of credits; this is an access blocker, not negative evidence. Searched entry documents this unsuccessful numeric path without treating absences as measured zero.
